body:
> The following is my (mostly Claude's) understanding of the issue.

Please see [this](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/development/contribution_rules.html#for-contributors), if you are using AI tools to assist in investigating issues please make sure to verify any AI output before pasting it

Also reproduces on master d824ca9fe2, M1 on macOS 26.2.

The imported texture case can be checked without a GDExtension by importing the native handle of a texture you just made. For a 256x256 RGBA8 texture, creating and freeing a shared view or an imported copy each takes 264192 off the counter on Metal, and nothing on Vulkan:

```
metal
texture_create: +264192
shared view, created and freed: -264192
texture_create_from_extension, created and freed: -264192
total after freeing everything: -528384

vulkan
texture_create: +264192
shared view, created and freed: +0
texture_create_from_extension, created and freed: +0
total after freeing everything: +0
```

To reproduce the imported case:
```gdscript
var rd := RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
var fmt := RDTextureFormat.new()
fmt.width = 256
fmt.height = 256
fmt.format = RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM
fmt.usage_bits = RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_SAMPLING_BIT | RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_USAGE_CAN_UPDATE_BIT
var texture := rd.texture_create(fmt, RDTextureView.new())
var handle := rd.get_driver_resource(RenderingDevice.DRIVER_RESOURCE_TEXTURE, texture, 0)
var before := rd.get_memory_usage(RenderingDevice.MEMORY_TEXTURES)
var imported := rd.texture_create_from_extension(RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_TYPE_2D, fmt.format,
		RenderingDevice.TEXTURE_SAMPLES_1, fmt.usage_bits, handle, 256, 256, 1, 1)
rd.free_rid(imported)
# frees are deferred, so wait a few frames, then compare get_memory_usage() with `before`
```
